CustomField.description: A request is valid if it is related to a Contact and Opportunity, or Lead, and if if is a Lead, the lead must be more than 30 minutes old.
CustomField.formula:
IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Conversion_Status__c, "NEW"), NOT(ISBLANK( Click_ID__c )), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Related_Lead__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Related_Opportunity__c))),
OR( (NOW() - Send_Time__c) * 24 * 60 > 0, (NOW() - Related_Opportunity__r.CreatedDate) * 24 * 60 > 0)), TRUE, FALSE) && IF( AND(Send_Time__c < (NOW() - (2/24)), Send_Time__c > NOW() - 14), TRUE, FALSE)
CustomField.label: Valid Request?
